intro: Mali is one of Africa's biggest gold producers, and most people farm or herd.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Gold is the main export, followed by cotton. Millet, sorghum and rice are grown along the Niger, and herders raise cattle, sheep and goats.

chapters.title: Abroad
text: Money from Malians abroad, especially in France, helps many families.

cardGroups.title: Made in Mali
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Mali makes and sells to the world.
